newsitem.title: USA: Huntsman says still interested in buying Rexene. [CORRECTED 18:28 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Huntsman says still interested in buying Rexene. [CORRECTED 18:28 GMT]

text.p: Chemical company Huntsman Corp said Friday it was still interested in acquiring Rexene Corp.
"We believe that Rexene would be an excellent strategic fit with our Huntsman businesses," it said.
In October (corrects from January), the company made an unsolicited cash offer of $16 a share. Rexene rejected it, saying it did not meet its conditions.

"After reading materials submitted to shareholders by Rexene, we believe that Rexene's current management has not characterized accurately our dealings with them during the summer and fall of 1996 when we attempted to negotiate a merger transaction," said Huntsman.
The company also said it had "followed with interest" Rexene's proxy contest initiated by Spear Leeds and Guy Wyser-Pratte.
Spear and Wyser-Pratte, who own about 10 percent of Rexene, have called for a special shareholders meeting.
Although Rexene's opposes the meeting, a proxy monitor recently supported the call for one. Spear and Wyser-Pratte want the company to be sold at $16 a share with a new board of directors.
